title: Televiziunea Română Liberă — 22 decembrie 1989, în direct
license: unknown (TVR archive material, uploader copy of the uncut live feed)
notes: the uncut live feed from Bucharest the day the studio changed hands: the crowded studio and the papers being read, the row of microphones, the tvr ident card still being played out between statements, silhouettes on a balcony in the floodlit haze at night, and the caption the station gave itself — TELEVIZIUNEA ROMÂNA LIBERA. Fragments only; no statement is carried whole
